lines.zh: 我拖着巨大的身体在水里走。
lines.en: I drag my huge body through the water.

lines.zh: 长吻劈开水流，我拱过去。
lines.en: My long snout splits the current as I push on.
One swing of my tail scatters the water.
I skim the riverbed in a slow sweep.

lines.zh: 背鳍划开浅水，泥翻上来。
lines.en: My dorsal fin cuts the shallows and stirs mud.

lines.zh: 我转身很费劲，得绕大圈。
lines.en: Turning is hard work; I need a wide arc.

lines.zh: 我沿着岸边巡，找能咬的。
lines.en: I patrol the bank, looking for something to bite.
A long ripple trails behind me.
I slide into the ribs of a sunken wreck.

lines.zh: 我碾过水草，泥翻了起来
lines.en: I crush the weeds and the mud rolls up.
I rise to midwater for a better view.

lines.zh: 这条水道太窄，我挤过去。
lines.en: Too narrow here; I squeeze through.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地跟着那道影子。
lines.en: I follow that shadow slowly.

lines.zh: 吻尖碰到石头，我偏了偏。
lines.en: My snout hits stone and I veer off.

lines.zh: 我挨着礁壁游，那里有躲的。
lines.en: I hug the reef wall, where things hide.

lines.zh: 我的身体挡住了半条河。
lines.en: My body blocks half the river.
I hang in the water, snout forward.

lines.zh: 腮一张一合，我慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: Gills open and close; I breathe slowly.
I'm waiting for the water to change taste.

lines.zh: 一动不动的我像根沉木。
lines.en: Holding still, I look like sunken timber.
A row of fine teeth lines my mouth.
Current brushes along my lateral line.
I hear someone walking on the bank.

lines.zh: 我的眼珠转到侧面看你
lines.en: My eye rolls sideways to you.
The light down here is murky.
I'm waiting for something to fall in.
My tail sways gently.

lines.zh: 我一点也不饿，可我还是想咬。
lines.en: I'm not hungry, and still I want to bite.
My scales shine in the dark.
I rest my snout on the sand.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，我看着你的腿。
lines.en: You're on the bank; I'm watching your legs.
I lift my snout out of the water.

lines.zh: 我们之间只有一层水面。
lines.en: Only a layer of water between us.
One step back from you, one foot forward from me.
I know the two-legged kind.

lines.zh: 我的身体比你整个人都长。
lines.en: My body is longer than you are tall.
That long thing you're holding up.
The current runs toward me.
I paddle over slowly.
You're looking at my teeth.

lines.zh: 我猛摆了一下尾，水都翻了。
lines.en: One hard swing of my tail and the water turns over.

lines.zh: 我身上裂开一道，血散开。
lines.en: A split opens on me and blood clouds out.
I retreat a long way before turning.
That bit into my flank.
My fin's bent; I swim crooked.
The tip of my snout has gone blunt.

lines.zh: 我身上那道口子还在淌
lines.en: The gash on me is still bleeding.

lines.zh: 我伏进河底的淤泥里喘
lines.en: I lie in the river silt and breathe.
A cut like this won't stop me.

lines.zh: 血顺着侧线渗进我的鳃
lines.en: Blood seeps to my gills along the lateral line.
Blood reached the water.

lines.zh: 我立刻转向，一点没犹豫。
lines.en: I turn at once, no hesitation.
Too small a piece; I swallow it whole.
I'm no plant-eater.
Throw it in; I'll catch it.
The taste is spreading through the water.
I keep my mouth open and wait.
More — I'm still hungry.
I prefer it alive.
Don't wash the blood off on the bank.

lines.zh: 你撞在我侧面，像撞上墙。
lines.en: You hit my flank like hitting a wall.
My body drops and shoves the water aside.
The wave pushes you away.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我吻尖歪了一下。
lines.en: That knock skewed my snout a little.
I turn around, very slowly.

lines.zh: 这条水道容不下我们两个。
lines.en: This channel can't hold both of us.
I press to the bank to let you pass.

lines.zh: 我的侧腹撞出一圈水纹
lines.en: A ring of ripples spreads from my flank.
I back off two feet.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踢到了我的背。
lines.en: Your boot kicked my back.
Another long shadow approaches.
We float side by side, slowly.
The current curls between us.

lines.zh: 我用吻碰了碰它的侧腹。
lines.en: I touch its flank with my snout.
This deep water is enough for us.
We sink down together.
The weeds block the light.
It flicks its tail; so do I.
The river will be busy this season.
We part and swim our own ways.
I snap up the dead fish.
Something bright on the bottom.
I hold it in my mouth.
Too hard a bone; I spit it out.
I swallow it without chewing.
There's still meat in this shell.
I nose it aside.
It's stuck between my teeth.
I take it away to eat slowly.
That little won't fill a gap in my teeth.
Someone's walking the bank.
I spotted it from twenty blocks off.
I sink low along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我的吻尖对准了那条腿。
lines.en: My snout points at that leg.

lines.zh: 他还没发现水里有什么。
lines.en: It hasn't noticed what's in the water.
I build speed slowly.
Once I've locked on, I don't let go.

lines.zh: 水花起来之前，他听不到我。
lines.en: It won't hear me before the splash.
I pick the shallowest stretch.
I'm going for the waist.
I follow the shadow along the bank.

lines.zh: 他在岸上走，我在水里并着。
lines.en: It walks the bank; I keep pace in the water.

lines.zh: 我等一个它必须靠近水的时机。
lines.en: I wait for a moment it must come near water.

lines.zh: 我的吻一直指着同一处。
lines.en: My snout stays pointed at one spot.
The surface shows the barest ripple.
It crouches to tie a lace; I hold still.
I wait for it to reach in.
I know this channel better than it does.

lines.zh: 我的身体在水下已经转好角度。
lines.en: I've already angled my body under the surface.
One more step and I can open my mouth.
My snout stabs straight out.
I bite down and my teeth lock.
I shake my head and drag it into the water.
The water bursts and it thrashes.
My tail sweeps and knocks it down.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，它骨头都在响。
lines.en: I ram it and its bones rattle.
It breaks loose, blood in the water.
I roll over and bite again.

lines.zh: 牙咬到底，磕到了硬东西
lines.en: My teeth reach bone and hit something hard.
I pin it to the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我从深水里浮上来，很长。
lines.en: I rise out of the deep, very long.
My back heaves a wave across the river.
My first breath tastes of silt.
I lift my head; the surface is bright.
Deep water all around — just right.
I slowly stretch my body out.

lines.zh: 我看见岸上有东西在动。
lines.en: I see something moving on the bank.
I start working toward the shallows.
My shadow runs long under the surface.
My snout breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 水在烧，我的鳞翻卷起来。
lines.en: The water burns and my scales curl.

lines.zh: 我被甩上岸，砸在石头上。
lines.en: I'm flung onto the bank and hit the stones.
Water floods my mouth and I thrash.
The blast underwater flips me over.

lines.zh: 一根长矛穿过我的侧腹。
lines.en: A spear passes through my flank.

lines.zh: 有东西在我体内烧，没有火。
lines.en: Something burns inside me, with no flame.

lines.zh: 猎物越来越少，我瘦得露骨。
lines.en: The prey's thinned out and my bones show.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水打进来，我僵住了。
lines.en: Lightning comes through the water and I lock up.
The riverbed is gone; I'm dropping.
